description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, proudly Canadian since 2005, with over 385 locations. This Nanaimo outpost sits inside Port Place mall on Terminal Avenue, offering build-your-own Mexican-inspired meals including burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas with a wide range of proteins and toppings. It's a quick, no-fuss refuelling stop for cyclists passing through central Nanaimo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (648 Terminal Ave, Nanaimo, BC) and phone number ((250) 591-2235), and establishes the business is an active, operating BarBurrito franchise in Port Place mall. The nutrition calculator page explicitly lists 'Gluten Free' as a tortilla option and 'Veggie Ground' as a protein, confirming vegetarian and GF choices. Takeout is confirmed via 'Order Pickup' and third-party delivery options (DoorDash, SkipTheDishes, Uber Eats) listed on the location page; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
